lines.zh: 两条细腿跑得很快，我压着草走。
lines.en: Two thin legs move fast; I skim the grass.

lines.zh: 我身体前倾，像随时要冲。
lines.en: Leaning forward, I look ready to bolt.
I follow the fallen logs, sniffing as I go.
My forelimbs are short, but the claw is sharp.

lines.zh: 我停下来，用单爪敲了敲木头。
lines.en: I stop and tap the wood with my single claw.

lines.zh: 我踩在枯枝上，噼啪作响。
lines.en: Dry twigs crackle under me.
One hop clears the little ditch.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木走，身子很小。
lines.en: I keep to the shrubs; I'm small.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把脖子伸前。
lines.en: I walk with my neck stretched forward.

lines.zh: 我绕开一堆落叶，那里可能有虫。
lines.en: I go around a leaf pile — there might be bugs.

lines.zh: 我从树干上刮了点东西吃。
lines.en: I scrape something off the trunk and eat it.

lines.zh: 我沿着林下的阴处走，凉快。
lines.en: I take the shade under the trees; it's cooler.

lines.zh: 我又回到那棵倒木边上。
lines.en: I'm back at that fallen log.
My stride is choppy, my steps short.

lines.zh: 我把头一偏，听木头里的声音。
lines.en: I cock my head to listen inside the wood.

lines.zh: 我绕了半个圈，又回到原地。
lines.en: I go half round and end up where I was.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见一只虫在爬。
lines.en: I look up and see a bug climbing.
I crouch with my forelimbs tucked in.
I tilt my head to one side and listen.

lines.zh: 我的单爪在木头上轻轻敲。
lines.en: My single claw taps lightly on the wood.
Wind moves through the trees and I squint.

lines.zh: 我在等木头里有什么动。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something to move in the wood.
My tail is up and straight.
A bug crawls near; I hold still.
My toes grip the bark.
Sun comes down through gaps in the leaves.
I lick my single claw.
I turn my head slowly.
I crouch almost to the ground.
You're close; I lift my head.
I fix you with one eye, head tilted.
You're blocking the light.
I raise my forelimbs and put them down.
You're not something from inside the wood.
My single claw is for prying wood apart.
I stare at the bugs in your boot seam.
You carry a heavy smell.
I lift my claw a little.
I squeak and leap far away.

lines.zh: 我趴在地上，翅膀似的鳞在抖。
lines.en: I lie there with my scale-fringe trembling.

lines.zh: 我的一只腿不太敢用力。
lines.en: One of my legs won't take weight.
I duck into the roots.
I look back at you and run on.
It hurts, but I can still run.
My claw has drawn blood.
I keep that blow in my claw tip.
Bugs — I smell bugs.
My neck goes out at once.
Don't move; I'll get it.
Not enough for one tooth.
I tilt my head to look at it.
I peck it up.
Bugs inside the wood smell sweet.
Lower your hand.
My claw is scratching the dirt.
One bug, one bite is enough.

lines.zh: 你撞了我，我翻了个跟头。
lines.en: You bumped me and I rolled over.
I'm small; you didn't see me.
I hop away and look back at you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的爪刮到你了。
lines.en: That knocked my claw into you.
This single claw digs into wood.
We collide and both stop.
I shake and steady myself.
I'm far lighter than you.
I dodged around you and ran.

lines.zh: 另一只从树根边钻出来。
lines.en: Another slips out from by the roots.
We look at each other, heads tilted.
I touch it with my claw.
Our tails swing against each other.
We crouch side by side on the fallen log.

lines.zh: 它敲了一下木头，我听见了。
lines.en: It taps the wood and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我们一起听同一个声音。
lines.en: We listen to the same sound.
This dead wood is enough to forage.
We go half round and stop.
I peck up the bug and swallow.
There's something under this bark.
Too small; it slipped out.
I carry it in my jaws.
I chew this bit of wood.
Odd taste; I spat it out.
I flick it aside with my claw.
I carry it two steps.
I tuck it into a tree crack.
There's a sound inside the wood.
I tilt my head to listen.
I push my claw into the crack.
It's right under the bark.
I crouch back, ready.

lines.zh: 我的前肢很短，可爪子很利。
lines.en: My forelimbs are short, but the claw is sharp.
A bug — good.
I've fixed on that seam.
I start tapping, tap by tap.
It's coming out.
I've heard it clearly in the wood.

lines.zh: 我把身体压得很低，单爪对着木头。
lines.en: I press low, my single claw aimed at the wood.
I circle the trunk after it.
It goes left; I block left.
I tap the other side to drive it out.
I'm patient; no rush.
It stops; so do I.
I herd it toward the opening.
I dip my head and wait.
It's poking out a little.
I'm very close.
It's running for the other end.

lines.zh: 我一下一下敲，很有耐心。
lines.en: I tap and tap, patiently.
It shrinks deeper into the crack.
I peck it up.
My claw strikes downward.
I whip my head down.

lines.zh: 这一下敲在木头上，很响。
lines.en: That landed on the wood, loudly.
I've dragged it out of the crack.
Three quick pecks.
It broke free and went back in.
I tap again.
My claw split the bark.
I've pinned it against the wood.
I squeeze out from a gap in the roots.
The first thing I see is the forest floor.
I crouch and listen first.
The dead leaves are loud under me.

lines.zh: 我把爪子抬起来试了试。
lines.en: I raise my claw and test it.
There's plenty of dead wood here.

lines.zh: 我抬头看树皮上有没有洞。
lines.en: I check the bark for holes.
The wind smells of wood.
I move toward the nearest tree.
One hop puts me on the fallen log.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的细鳞，我乱跳。
lines.en: Fire catches my fine scales and I leap about.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，翻了几个跟头。
lines.en: I fall out of the tree and roll over and over.

lines.zh: 水进了我的鼻孔，我拼命挣。
lines.en: Water's in my nostrils; I thrash.
The blast slams me into a trunk.
An arrow grazes my flank.
No bugs under the bark; I'm thin.

lines.zh: 脚下的土没了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The soil's gone and I fall.
